newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-GLASGOW RANGERS V GRASSHOPPER TEAMS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-GLASGOW RANGERS V GRASSHOPPER TEAMS.

text.p: Teams for Wednesday's European Cup Champions' League group A match between Glasgow Rangers of Scotland and Switzerland's Grasshopper Zurich:

Glasgow Rangers - 1-Andy Goram; 2-Alex Cleland, 3-Joerg Albertz, 4-Richard Gough, 5-Gordan Petric, 9-Ally McCoist, 15-David Robertson, 16-Charlie Miller, 17-Peter Van Vossen, 23-Craig Moore, 29-Scott Wilson.

Grasshopper - 1-Pascal Zuberbuehler; 3-Pascal Thueler, 4-Mats Gren, 7-Antonio Esposito, 8-Alexandre Comisetti, 10-Massimo Lombardo, 11-Kubilay Turkyilmaz, 14-Johann Vogel, 19-Joel Magnin, 28-Bernt Haas, 29-Boris Smiljanic.
